messages:
jen.prod: Quick internal heads-up: launching Hosted API \u201cfast-path\u201d router config today to prioritize low-latency model variants for interactive apps. This is a GA callout for hosted endpoints (chat/text, streaming, tool-calling).

jen.prod: Key points: 1) interactive routes will prefer low-latency quantized variants, 2) adaptive batching defaults changed for interactive flag, 3) new client header X-RW-Perf-Hint to hint 'interactive' vs 'throughput'. Full internal doc: https://redwood.internal/hosted/fast-path (internal).

ravi.eng: can you share the rollout times?

jen.prod: schedule: canary starts at 2024-08-01T01:00Z, wide flip at 2024-08-01T07:00Z. Canary will be limited to 2% of traffic initially.

ana-sre: ops note: fallback sequence -> warm quantized variant -> compatible smaller-context model -> sync non-stream endpoint if streaming stalls. We'll keep a 3-minute warm cache window.

ravi.eng: will SDKs surface X-RW-Perf-Hint?

jen.prod: next SDK patch will include a perfHint option; until then clients can set header manually. Example: `X-RW-Perf-Hint: interactive`.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout scheduled: hosted-fast-path-router v1.0 canary @2024-08-01T01:00:00Z (2% traffic) -> wide @2024-08-01T07:00:00Z. Watch metrics: latency.p50, latency.p90, fallback.count, resource.cpu_util.

ravi.eng: any UX impact for streaming UIs?

jen.prod: streaming chunk cadence might tighten (smaller initial delay) for interactive routes. If your client measures chunk timing, validate against staging.

ana-sre: health thresholds: if fallback.count > 4% sustained for 10m or latency.p90 regresses >20% vs baseline, automated rollback will trigger. We'll post gate events in #eng-monitoring.

ravi.eng: thanks. pls share short checklist for mobile teams.

jen.prod: will drop a mobile checklist in #devex with snips and backoff recs in ~20m.

ana-sre: added runbook link to the doc.

jen.prod: thanks team \u2014 ping me with any immediate concerns during the canary.
